item.title: María Corina Machado Returns to Venezuela
item.description: After nearly 10 months in exile, Ms. Machado, a Nobel laureate, came back to challenge leaders who have sidelined her and press for new elections.

item.title: Jordan Arrests 3 in Connection With Church Attack, State Media Reports
item.description: Nine people were killed and dozens were wounded in the attack last week on a Greek Orthodox Church in southern Jordan.

item.title: Convicted Australian Murderer Loses Bid to Eat Vegemite in Prison
item.description: A judge agreed that denying the staple restricted the prisoner’s cultural rights but ruled that keeping drug dogs focused and cells free of illicit home brew was more important.

item.title: Chris Brown Gets Suspended Prison Sentence Over Nightclub Assault
item.description: The singer, 37, had pleaded guilty after hitting a music producer repeatedly in the head with a bottle in London in 2023. He is unlikely to serve any prison time.

item.title: What to Know About Lula’s Election Victory in Brazil, and What Comes Next
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won a fourth term, halting a string of conservative victories in Latin America. His opponent disputed the result.
